title: Moonwake Garden
summary: A pocket-sized, three-part ambient-light garden whose hidden 70 mm sector dial reveals one fixed petal constellation at each of three tactile positions.
interaction: Hold the face toward a brighter background and roll the exposed right-side rotor grip through the three 120-degree indexed positions to reveal Cassiopeia, Cygnus, and an Ursa Minor Little Dipper reading.
cad_status: isolated fresh full-tier verification passed; custom audits are relocation-safe and two independent builds produced byte-identical declared STEP outputs

creative_binding.repair: 70.0 mm rotor, 70.8 mm guide ID, 74.8 mm guide OD, radially translated annular detent, printable blended grip trench, and knife-edge-free relief/snap construction

checks: two-process byte reproducibility for the combined and three part STEP outputs
strict three-part bed and fit audit
exact 5/6/7 optical-state and full-turn leakage audit
360-degree rotor motion and axial capture proxies
kernel reference, validation, and assembly interference checks
0.4 mm-nozzle wall-thickness gates with zero failing samples on all three parts

physical_limits: No physical print, printer-process fit, or support-free outcome has been observed.
Snap insertion force, retention, service removal, whitening, fracture, and fatigue remain unverified.
Detent force, feel, wear, and bidirectional cycle life remain unverified.
Optical brightness, off-axis appearance beyond the checked geometric rays, pocket comfort, recognition, discovery, and human response remain unverified.
